part.text:
Implemented the fix in `internal/builtin/provisioners/remote-exec/resource_provisioner.go:250`.

The provisioner now disconnects immediately once scripts finish, while still disconnecting on context cancellation (e.g. `Stop`). A `sync.Once` prevents double-disconnect races.

Validation: `go test ./internal/builtin/provisioners/remote-exec -count=1 -v` passes fully.
